Tracking issue for the six operator-ratified amendments in docs/issue-graph.md ledger item 27 (provenance: the software-factory pilot's friction report, 2026-08-08 — the first reverse-harvest from a pilot). Build order and lane plan:

3. **`land` verb** (fast lane) — one script: validate → push → PR → verify-lane → merge → teardown. Head approves; machine lands.

5. **Ratchet graduation valve** (contract edit) — bounded live Tightenings; overflow graduates into checks/validators/ledger rows, never deleted.

Each lane: red-first done-means, standard report, no variations. Seed doc updated with the amendments (docs/rlvr-pilot-seed.md) so future pilots start with them built in.
